note: Smart IP data source that geolocates offline against a MaxMind GeoIP2/GeoLite2 .mmdb file (via geoip2/geoip2). sourceId()='maxmind_geoip2_bin_db'; configName()='smart_ip_maxmind_geoip2_bin_db.settings' with keys version(lite|licensed, default lite), edition(city|country, default city), user_account, license_key, db_auto_update(default true), bin_file_custom_path. The IP lookup needs an external .mmdb file that is NOT present on this site, so medium/hard cases are grounded ONLY in config the agent can set without the binary DB: the edition (city vs country) and the db_auto_update flag. Shipped defaults used by reset/cleanup: edition=city, db_auto_update=true.

evals.prompt: I enabled the Smart IP MaxMind GeoIP2 binary database submodule. What value do I set for smart_ip.settings:data_source to make Smart IP use it, and where does this submodule keep its own settings?
evals.expected_output: Set smart_ip.settings:data_source to maxmind_geoip2_bin_db (its sourceId()). Its own settings live in the smart_ip_maxmind_geoip2_bin_db.settings config object.

evals.prompt: For the Smart IP MaxMind GeoIP2 binary database source, which config key chooses city-level vs country-level resolution, what values does it accept, and what is the default?
evals.expected_output: smart_ip_maxmind_geoip2_bin_db.settings:edition accepts city or country and defaults to city; version (lite|licensed) picks the free GeoLite2 vs the commercial GeoIP2 database.

evals.prompt: Does the Smart IP MaxMind GeoIP2 binary database source refresh its .mmdb database automatically on cron by default, and which config key controls that? What library reads the database?
evals.expected_output: Yes - db_auto_update defaults to true, so it refreshes the .mmdb on cron (download uses the MaxMind user_account + license_key). The reader is the geoip2/geoip2 PHP library; lookups are offline.

evals.prompt: On this live site the Smart IP MaxMind GeoIP2 binary database source has been switched away from its default resolution. Inspect the running configuration and state which edition (city or country) it is currently set to.
evals.expected_output: smart_ip_maxmind_geoip2_bin_db.settings:edition is country (read with `drush cget smart_ip_maxmind_geoip2_bin_db.settings edition`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the Smart IP MaxMind GeoIP2 binary database source so it does NOT auto-update its .mmdb database on cron (you will manage the database file yourself). Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set smart_ip_maxmind_geoip2_bin_db.settings:db_auto_update to false (boolean), e.g. `drush cset smart_ip_maxmind_geoip2_bin_db.settings db_auto_update 0 -y` or via the config factory setting FALSE.
